validity.researcher_notes: EIA Aug 2026 release shows MVP Southgate as 'Construction' status (changed from Approved in Jan 2026). Sheet records 'proposed' with 2028 in-service. FERC amended certificate dated 12/18/2025 per EIA; notice to proceed 3/23/2026 per EIA candidate section. The project appears to have moved from approved to under construction between Jan and Aug 2026. Original MVP Southgate proposed 2019-2020 (CP19-14), amended 2025 (CP25-60). Pipeline is real, the Southgate expansion is distinct from the main MVP line (P0220 and P4456 per batch note). Amended version reduces length from 75 mi to 31.3 mi, increases diameter from 16/24 in to 30 in, increases capacity from 375,000 to 550,000 Dth/d. Route: Transco Zone 5 Compressor Station 165 (Pittsylvania County, VA) to Rockingham County, NC.
